---
name: Bug report
about: Report an installation, update, provider, or runtime failure
---

## Version and setup

Include the Nook version or commit, channel, Linux distribution and version,
Python version, and affected provider if relevant.

## Steps to reproduce

Describe what you did, what happened, and what you expected. For an update,
include the source and target versions and the last successful step.

## Diagnostics

Include the relevant error or a short, redacted log. Remove tokens,
authorization headers, account IDs, and private conversations. Report possible
vulnerabilities privately using [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Sppqq/nook/security/policy).
